description: Call this when the user asks to review, audit, check, or validate Branch integration code, or a pull request that touches Branch API calls, webhook handlers, onboarding flows, or payouts. Returns Branch's audit checklist: critical violations, warnings, and passing checks for each standard solution, plus the report format to use. It catches patterns that mishandle KYC data or cause failed payouts.
name: audit-integration
title: Audit Integration
